name: Fuobe CCTV

dataset.what: Frames from cameras Fuobe controls (own CCTV, staged scenes with released actors); no timestamp or camera overlays in the frames.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbcctv style, " and goes on in one or two long sentences (Z-Image style): who or what is in the picture, where, the light and the framing.
Describe the scene, never the look the LoRA learns (no "grainy", "film look" or the like), so the trigger carries it.
No names of people, places that identify someone, brands, camera models or photographers.

notes: The timestamp and camera ID stay an overlay added after the picture.
